O  R  D  E  R
Application seeking condonation of delay in filing Review Petition is
allowed.
The concurrent view taken by the Sessions Court and the High Court
in convicting and sentencing the petitioner for having committed offence
punishable under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code
was under challenge before this Court. Having considered the matter, this
Court found no reasons to interfere and the Special Leave Petition was
dismissed. 
Digitally signed by
NEETU KHAJURIA
